nodes.name: auto_plot.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code PostToolUse hook that auto-plots simulation results. Reads a hook JSON payload from stdin, filters for `vcli sim sweep|measure` or `virtuoso sim sweep|measure` or `process char` commands with `--format json`, then invokes the Python helper `.claude/skills/sim-plot/scripts/plot_sim.py` to render a chart (line, bar, or gm/Id lookup) into `plots/<prefix>_<timestamp>.png`. Selects a plot prefix (`sweep` / `measure` / `gmid`) from the command verb, silently bails when jq/python3 are missing or JSON output is empty/unparsable, and returns a `systemMessage` via jq pointing to the saved PNG. Failures from plot_sim.py are deliberately swallowed.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file bash script with no named functions — control flow is a linear sequence of guard clauses (`exit 0`) followed by branch selection and a single Python invocation. Tree-sitter shell parser is not applied by the extractor; top-level functions: none. External deps: jq, python3, plot_sim.py. Uses `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` to anchor paths under the repo root.

nodes.name: eda_error_capture.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code PostToolUse hook that classifies EDA errors emitted by `vcli`, `virtuoso`, or `spectre` Bash invocations and saves them into per-skill `memory/` files via `.claude/skills/_shared/scripts/eda_memory_saver.py`. Reads the hook JSON from stdin, pre-filters the tool response with a regex covering SFE-/OSSHNL- codes, premature termination, IPC failures, bridge NAK, missing skill registration, nil netlists, connection refused, and exit 127; classifies the source as `spectre`/`vcli`/`unknown`; pipes the output through the saver; and surfaces a localized `systemMessage` (`[eda_capture] 已记录到 <skill>/memory/: <pattern>`) on success.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file bash script with no named functions; control flow is sequential guards and regex filters. External deps: jq, python3, eda_memory_saver.py. Contains a Chinese-language user-facing message; otherwise English comments.

nodes.name: rust_check.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code PostToolUse hook that auto-formats and lints Rust files after Write/Edit. Reads the hook JSON, validates that `tool_input.file_path` ends with `.rs` and lives under `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, then runs `rustfmt --edition 2021 --check` before and after `cargo fmt --quiet` to detect whether formatting was applied (emitting a systemMessage only on a before→after transition). If the file is formatted, runs `cargo clippy -q -- -D warnings`, extracts the first ten `error...` lines and up to five `= help:` hints, and surfaces them as a single systemMessage naming the file. Silently exits if rustfmt/jq are missing.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file bash script with no named functions; relies on bash-specific parameter expansion (`${FMT_BEFORE##*$'\n'}`) to recover the trailing exit status from a captured command. External deps: rustfmt, cargo, jq. Re-uses `cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"` before invoking cargo.
